description: 2D primitive — a circle of the given radius centred at (X, Y) in metres. Emits a Space polygon.
instructions:
A 2D primitive source — emits a circular Space (a 48-gon) of `radius` centred at (centerX, centerY) in metres. It has no geometry input; feed its output into the Space pipeline like a source. Publishes `val-radius` for wiring downstream.

TIP: use it for radial studies or as a seed Space; wire `val-radius` into downstream sizing, or into a Bounding Shapes / Inset chain.
